review.notes: Full token-level diff of all 22 physical PDF pages against the OCR markdown plus fence/heading inventory. Remaining diff hits were LaTeX-equivalent math, figure-internal text (Figure 1 control panels, Figure 5 benchmark panels, the Figure 10 annotation-UI screenshot that also carries the VIDEO_PROMPT box as an embedded image, so its text is shown by the embed), PDF line-break hyphenation inside references (e.g. 'On-lyflow' correctly joined to 'Onlyflow' in reference [11], visually verified at 300 dpi), superscript tokens in the author block, and page furniture (arXiv stamp, NeurIPS footer). The title-page author-note footnotes tied to the surviving *†‡ markers were dropped; confirmed on the rendered page and repaired below.
